repos.description: Transforms complex documents like PDFs and Office docs into LLM-ready markdown/JSON for your Agentic workflows.
repos.summary_zh: MinerU 是一款高效文档解析工具，可将 PDF 等复杂文档自动转换为 LLM 友好的结构化输出（Markdown/JSON），显著提升 Agentic 工作流的文档处理效率与数据可用性。
repos.summary_en: MinerU is a high-performance document parsing tool that transforms complex documents like PDFs into LLM-ready structured outputs (Markdown/JSON), significantly enhancing document processing efficiency and data accessibility for agentic workflows.

repos.description: A Simple and Universal Swarm Intelligence Engine, Predicting Anything. 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物
repos.summary_zh: MiroFish 是一款基于多智能体技术的群体智能预测引擎，通过构建高保真数字沙盘模拟现实世界演化。用户上传种子数据（如新闻、小说）并描述预测需求，系统自动生成智能体进行社会推演，最终输出详尽预测报告，适用于舆情分析、文学创作等场景。
repos.summary_en: MiroFish is a swarm intelligence prediction engine powered by multi-agent technology. It builds high-fidelity digital simulations from seed data (e.g., news, novels) and uses autonomous agents to simulate societal evolution. Users input natural language queries to receive detailed forecasts and interact with the simulated world, enabling applications in舆情预测, creative writing, and strategic planning.

repos.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repos.summary_zh: REA 是一款基于 AI 智能体的逆向工程工具，支持从应用程序行为到原生二进制的全栈代码审查。它通过 MCP 协议无缝集成 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流 AI 助手，可静态分析 JavaScript、.NET 及动态分析二进制文件，支持 Hopper/Ghidra 引擎，帮助开发者深入理解软件实现机制并快速复用功能。
repos.summary_en: REA is an AI agent-driven reverse engineering tool for full-stack code inspection from app behavior to native binaries. It integrates with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI assistants via MCP protocol, supporting static analysis of JavaScript, .NET assemblies, and dynamic binary analysis with Hopper/Ghidra engines. Developers can inspect undocumented apps, understand implementation details, and rebuild features for their own projects.

repos.description: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
repos.summary_zh: 专为AI代理设计的营销技能集，涵盖CRO、文案撰写、SEO、数据分析和增长工程。基于Agent Skills规范构建，支持Claude Code等主流编码代理，为技术型营销人员和创始人提供自动化营销解决方案，通过标准化技能文件实现跨平台协作与知识复用。
repos.summary_en: A collection of AI agent skills for marketing tasks including CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering. Built on the Agent Skills spec for use with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and other agents. Provides standardized workflows for technical marketers and founders to automate conversion optimization, content creation, and growth strategies.

repos.description: Developer-first error tracking and performance monitoring
repos.summary_zh: Sentry 是一款开发者优先的错误追踪与性能监控平台，提供实时问题检测、错误追踪、性能分析和用户行为回放功能，支持 20+ 编程语言和框架的官方 SDK，助力团队快速定位并修复代码缺陷。
repos.summary_en: Sentry is a developer-first error tracking and performance monitoring platform that enables real-time issue detection, error tracing, performance insights, and user session replay. It supports 20+ languages via official SDKs, helping teams debug and resolve problems faster.

repos.description: 微舆：人人可用的多Agent舆情分析助手，打破信息茧房，还原舆情原貌，预测未来走向，辅助决策！从0实现，不依赖任何框架。
repos.summary_zh: 微舆（BettaFish）是一个从0实现的多Agent舆情分析系统，通过AI驱动的全域社媒监控、复合分析引擎、多模态内容解析及Agent协作机制，打破信息茧房，还原舆情原貌并预测趋势。系统支持公私域数据融合，具备轻量化Python架构与高扩展性，可快速定制至金融等垂直领域。
repos.summary_en: BettaFish is a zero-to-one implemented multi-Agent public opinion analysis system that breaks information cocoons and predicts trends through AI-driven social media monitoring, hybrid analysis engines, and agent collaboration. It supports private-public data fusion, offers lightweight Python architecture, and enables rapid customization for vertical domains like finance.

repos.description: 结巴中文分词
repos.summary_zh: 结巴（jieba）是Python最优秀的中文分词组件，支持精确、全模式、搜索引擎及Paddle深度学习模式四种分词方式，具备新词发现、自定义词典和词性标注能力，采用前缀词典与HMM模型结合的高效算法，适用于文本分析、搜索引擎等场景。
repos.summary_en: Jieba is the best Python-based Chinese text segmentation module, supporting four modes: precise, full, search engine, and Paddle deep learning. It features new word discovery, custom dictionaries, and part-of-speech tagging, using efficient algorithms like prefix dictionaries and HMM models for text analysis and search engines.

repos.description: 前端精读周刊。帮你理解最前沿、实用的技术。
repos.summary_zh: 前端精读周刊是一个深度技术分享平台，聚焦前沿前端技术解析、源码解读与工程实践，涵盖React、JavaScript、编译原理等核心领域，结合大厂经验提供高质量技术洞察，助力开发者提升工程能力。
repos.summary_en: Frontend Weekly is a premium technical publication that delivers in-depth analysis of cutting-edge frontend technologies, including React, JavaScript, and compilation principles. It combines insights from industry experts to provide practical engineering knowledge and elevate developer capabilities.

repos.description: 插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
repos.summary_zh: MusicFree 是一款开源、无广告、插件化的免费音乐播放器，专为 Android 和 Harmony OS 设计。其核心特性包括完全本地化数据存储、支持自定义主题与歌词关联功能。通过插件架构，用户可接入第三方音源（如音乐搜索、歌单导入、歌词获取），实现高度定制化体验。项目基于 AGPL 3.0 协议开源，强调隐私保护与合法合规使用。
repos.summary_en: MusicFree is an open-source, ad-free, plugin-based music player for Android and Harmony OS. It features local data storage, customizable themes, and lyric linking. Its plugin architecture enables integration with third-party audio sources for search, playback, and playlist import. Built on AGPL 3.0, it prioritizes privacy and ethical use without VIP or cracked content.

repos.description: 数字生命卡兹克开源的 AI Skills 合集 | Agent Skills: leader（帮你定义目标）, neat-freak 洁癖, hv-analysis, khazix-writer & more — Claude Code, Codex & 40+ agents
repos.summary_zh: Khazix Skills 是一个开源的 AI 技能合集，包含多个可直接集成到 Claude Code、Codex 等智能体平台的结构化指令（Skills）和通用提示词（Prompts）。核心功能包括自动同步项目文档与记忆（neat-freak）、深度行业分析生成万字 PDF 报告（hv-analysis）以及个性化写作风格迁移（khazix-writer），旨在提升 AI 协作效率与输出一致性。
repos.summary_en: Khazix Skills is an open-source collection of AI skills and prompts designed for integration with agent platforms like Claude Code and Codex. It includes tools for auto-syncing project docs and agent memory (neat-freak), generating in-depth analytical reports via horizontal-vertical analysis (hv-analysis), and mimicking a personal writing style (khazix-writer), enhancing AI consistency and productivity.

repos.description: Visualize any GitHub codebase: free interactive architecture diagrams and one-minute explainer videos. Replace 'hub' with 'diagram' in any GitHub URL.
repos.summary_zh: GitDiagram 是一款免费的交互式 GitHub 仓库可视化工具，可将任意仓库结构秒级转换为系统架构图。支持点击组件跳转源码、导出 Mermaid 代码或 PNG 图片，集成 OpenAI GPT-5.2 实现智能分析，提供私有仓库支持与自托管部署方案，适用于快速理解复杂代码库。
repos.summary_en: GitDiagram is a free, fast tool that converts any GitHub repository into interactive architecture diagrams in seconds. It leverages OpenAI GPT-5.2 for intelligent analysis, supports clickable navigation to source files, exports Mermaid/PNG formats, and offers private repo support with self-hosting capabilities for deep codebase understanding.

repos.description: 1 Line of code data quality profiling & exploratory data analysis for Pandas and Spark DataFrames.
repos.summary_zh: fg-data-profiling 是一个用于 Pandas 和 Spark DataFrame 的数据质量分析与探索性数据分析（EDA）工具，仅需一行代码即可生成包含统计摘要、缺失值、相关性、时间序列和文本分析的详细报告，支持 HTML 和 JSON 导出，适用于快速数据洞察与质量评估。
repos.summary_en: fg-data-profiling is a one-line code tool for data quality profiling and exploratory data analysis (EDA) on Pandas and Spark DataFrames. It generates comprehensive reports including statistics, missing values, correlations, time-series, and text analysis, with export options in HTML and JSON for rapid data insights.

repos.description: 1 Line of code data quality profiling & exploratory data analysis for Pandas and Spark DataFrames.
repos.summary_zh: ydata-profiling 是一款极简的数据质量分析与探索性数据分析工具，支持 Pandas 和 Spark DataFrame。仅需一行代码即可生成包含缺失值、相关性、分布统计、时间序列和文本分析的完整报告，支持 HTML/JSON 导出，适用于快速数据洞察与 EDA 场景。
repos.summary_en: ydata-profiling is a one-line data profiling and exploratory data analysis tool for Pandas and Spark DataFrames. It generates comprehensive reports with type inference, missing data analysis, correlations, distributions, time-series insights, and text analysis, exporting to HTML or JSON for rapid EDA.

repos.description: 1 Line of code data quality profiling & exploratory data analysis for Pandas and Spark DataFrames.
repos.summary_zh: data-profiling 是一款极简的数据质量探查与探索性数据分析工具，支持 Pandas 和 Spark DataFrame。仅需一行代码即可生成包含类型推断、缺失值、相关性、时间序列及文本分析的全面报告，输出 HTML/JSON 格式，适用于快速数据洞察与 EDA 流程。
repos.summary_en: data-profiling is a one-line code solution for data quality profiling and exploratory data analysis (EDA) on Pandas and Spark DataFrames. It delivers comprehensive reports with type inference, missing values, correlations, time-series insights, and text analysis, exporting to HTML or JSON for rapid data understanding.

repos.description: 1 Line of code data quality profiling & exploratory data analysis for Pandas and Spark DataFrames.
repos.summary_zh: ydata-profiling 是一款强大的数据质量探查与探索性数据分析（EDA）工具，支持 Pandas 和 Spark DataFrame。仅需一行代码即可生成包含类型推断、缺失值分析、统计摘要、可视化图表、时间序列和文本分析的综合报告，支持 HTML 和 JSON 导出，显著提升数据理解效率。
repos.summary_en: ydata-profiling is a powerful data quality profiling and exploratory data analysis (EDA) tool for Pandas and Spark DataFrames. With just one line of code, it generates comprehensive reports including type inference, missing data analysis, statistical summaries, visualizations, time-series, and text analysis, exportable in HTML and JSON formats for rapid data insights.

repos.description: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes your Chrome browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex browser automation, content analysis, and semantic search.
repos.summary_zh: Chrome MCP Server 是一款基于 Chrome 扩展的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器，将浏览器功能暴露给 Claude 等 AI 助手，实现复杂浏览器自动化、内容分析与语义搜索。它直接利用用户现有 Chrome 环境，保留登录状态与配置，支持 20+ 工具，提供本地流式 HTTP 通信，并集成 SIMD 加速的向量数据库，实现智能跨标签页语义检索。
repos.summary_en: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex automation, content analysis, and semantic search. It leverages your existing Chrome browser with preserved login states and settings, supports 20+ tools, offers local streamable HTTP communication, and features SIMD-accelerated vector database for intelligent tab content discovery.

repos.description: GEO-first SEO skill for Claude Code. Comprehensive AI search optimization for any website — citability scoring, AI crawler analysis, brand authority, schema markup, platform-specific optimization, and PDF reports.  If you want learn how to sell this to real businesses, check out the skool community
repos.summary_zh: 专为 Claude Code 设计的 GEO-first SEO 技能，提供全面的 AI 搜索引擎优化服务，包括内容可引用性评分、AI 爬虫分析、品牌权威性评估、结构化数据生成及跨平台优化，支持 PDF 报告输出，助力企业抢占 AI 流量入口。
repos.summary_en: A GEO-first SEO skill for Claude Code that delivers comprehensive AI search optimization, including citability scoring, AI crawler analysis, brand authority assessment, schema markup generation, and platform-specific tuning, with professional PDF reporting capabilities to capture high-converting AI-driven traffic.

repos.description: 收集一些Loon、Surge、QuantumultX、ShadowRocket、Egern的配置与去广告规则。
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供 Loon、Surge、Quantumult X 等代理工具的配置与去广告规则，涵盖抖音、微博等主流 App 的广告过滤与 IP 修改功能，支持 MITM 响应体解析，适用于净化网络环境，提升使用体验。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers configuration files and ad-blocking rules for Loon, Surge, Quantumult X, and other proxy tools, including ad removal for apps like Douyin and Weibo, with MITM-based response parsing to enhance browsing experience.

repos.description: 输入SQL，输出索引优化建议
repos.summary_zh: SQLAdvisor 是美团点评 DBA 团队开发的 SQL 索引优化工具，基于 MySQL 词法解析分析 WHERE、JOIN 等条件，智能生成索引优化建议。已在内部广泛应用，支持开源协作与持续迭代，提供完整文档与社区支持。
repos.summary_en: SQLAdvisor is an index optimization tool developed by Meituan-Dianping's DBA team, analyzing SQL queries via MySQL's native lexer to generate intelligent index suggestions based on WHERE, JOIN, and aggregation conditions. Widely used internally, it supports open-source collaboration with comprehensive documentation and community feedback channels.

repos.description: ⭐This is a lightweight kit for generating astrolabes for Zi Wei Dou Shu (The Purple Star Astrology), an ancient Chinese astrology. It allows you to obtain your horoscope and personality analysis. 支持多语言轻量级获取紫微斗数排盘信息的javascript开源库。
repos.summary_zh: iztro 是一个轻量级紫微斗数排盘 JavaScript 库，支持多语言输入输出，可生成星盘数据、生肖星座、四柱运限及四化分析，提供链式调用和插件扩展，适用于个人命理分析、文化应用开发及学术研究。
repos.summary_en: iztro is a lightweight JavaScript library for generating Zi Wei Dou Shu astrolabes, supporting multi-language input/output, star charts, zodiac signs, four pillars, luck cycles, and four transformations. It offers chainable APIs, plugin extensibility, and is ideal for astrology apps, cultural tools, and research.

repos.description: 微信4.x数据解密并生成年度总结，高仿微信，实时更新，导出和修改聊天记录，朋友圈，收藏，自动回复等大量便捷功能
repos.summary_zh: 微信4.x数据解密与分析工具，支持聊天记录、朋友圈解密与可视化，提供高仿微信界面的年度总结生成、实时更新、搜索及导出功能，涵盖联系人管理与多消息类型展示。
repos.summary_en: WeChat 4.x data decryption and analysis tool with chat history, Moments decryption, annual summary generation, real-time updates, search, export, and contact management features, featuring a WeChat-like interface.

repos.description: 签到
repos.summary_zh: qiandao 是一个基于 HAR 编辑器的自动化签到框架，支持多平台自动签到任务管理。核心功能包括通过 HAR 文件录制与编辑浏览器操作，结合 Python 脚本实现定时自动签到，支持邮件通知与数据库存储。提供 Web 管理界面与 Docker 部署方案，适用于各类周期性签到场景，如论坛、学习平台等。
repos.summary_en: Qiandao is an automated check-in framework based on HAR editor, enabling scheduled check-ins across multiple platforms. It records and edits browser actions via HAR files, executes tasks using Python scripts, and supports email notifications and database storage. Features include a web admin interface and Docker deployment, ideal for recurring check-in scenarios such as forums and learning platforms.

repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是冬瓜关于 Pi-Agent SDK 的深度学习笔记，系统拆解了生产级 AI Agent 运行时的核心架构。教程涵盖 Agent Loop、工具系统、事件驱动等 10 大模块，通过 TypeScript 与 Python 双语言对照，深入剖析了 Agent SDK 的设计取舍与源码实现，适合希望构建或理解 Agent 底层逻辑的开发者。
repos.summary_en: A deep-dive tutorial repository on the Pi-Agent SDK, systematically deconstructing the core architecture of production-grade AI Agent runtimes. Covering 10 modules including Agent Loop, tool systems, and event-driven design, it provides TypeScript and Python dual-language comparisons to analyze the source code and design trade-offs of Agent SDKs for developers.

repos.description: 🚀 A statistical analysis tool for performance testing
repos.summary_zh: Hiper 是一款专为性能测试设计的统计分析工具，支持通过 Chrome 浏览器自动化采集页面加载时间、DNS 查询、TCP 连接等关键性能指标，提供详细的统计报告与可视化分析，适用于 Web 性能监控与优化。
repos.summary_en: Hiper is a statistical analysis tool for performance testing that automates Chrome browser interactions to collect key metrics like DNS lookup, TCP connection, and page load times, delivering detailed reports and visualizations for web performance monitoring and optimization.

repos.description: AI-powered daily intelligence for indie hackers and builders. 20 questions, 10+ sources, every morning.
repos.summary_zh: BuilderPulse 为独立开发者和创业者提供每日AI驱动的智能简报，聚合Hacker News、GitHub、Product Hunt等300+信号源数据，每日生成20个关键洞察与可执行建议，帮助快速发现高价值项目机会。
repos.summary_en: BuilderPulse delivers AI-powered daily intelligence for indie hackers and builders, curating 20 insights from 10+ sources including Hacker News, GitHub, and Product Hunt to surface actionable project ideas every morning.

repos.description: 🐹 Cleanup, app management, maintenance, disk analysis, and live status in one free, open-source, native Mac app + extensive support for AI agents.
repos.summary_zh: Burrow 是一款开源免费的 macOS 原生系统管理工具，集垃圾清理、应用卸载、磁盘分析、重复文件查找和实时状态监控于一体。内置 MCP 服务器，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 代理安全可控地监控和维护 Mac，所有操作可审计、可回滚。
repos.summary_en: Burrow is a free, open-source native macOS system management tool that combines junk cleanup, app uninstallation, disk analysis, duplicate finding, and live status monitoring. It features a built-in MCP server for AI agents like Claude Code and Cursor to safely monitor and maintain your Mac, with all actions consent-gated, audited, and reversible.

repos.description: Hacknical, hacker & technical. A website for GitHub user to make a better resume.
repos.summary_zh: Hacknical 是一个专为 GitHub 用户打造的在线简历生成平台，通过深度分析用户的 GitHub 贡献、代码仓库、技术栈等数据，自动生成可视化分析报告，帮助用户打造专业、数据驱动的编程简历。支持中英文切换、组织账号分析、移动端展示及 PDF 导出，技术栈涵盖 React、Koa2、MongoDB 等。
repos.summary_en: Hacknical is a web platform designed for GitHub users to generate data-driven resumes by analyzing their GitHub contributions, repositories, and tech stacks. It provides visual analytics and exportable reports, supporting English, organizations, mobile viewing, and PDF export with a tech stack including React, Koa2, and MongoDB.

repos.description: Boss直聘爬虫 / BOSS直聘职位数据抓取工具，基于 Chrome CDP 协议复用真实登录态，绕过字体反爬，输出明文薪资 JSON/CSV + 薪资技能分析。A Chrome-CDP-based BOSS Zhipin job scraper/crawler.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Chrome CDP 协议的 BOSS直聘职位抓取工具，通过复用本地真实登录态调用官方搜索 API，有效绕过前端字体反爬机制，直接获取明文薪资数据。支持 JSON/CSV 双格式输出，并提供薪资分布、技能词频分析及求职材料优化提示词生成，可作为 CLI 工具或 Hermes Agent Skill 使用。
repos.summary_en: A Chrome CDP-based BOSS Zhipin job scraper that leverages local authenticated sessions to invoke official search APIs, effectively bypassing font anti-scraping to extract plain-text salary data. It supports JSON/CSV output and provides salary distribution analysis, skill frequency statistics, and job application prompt generation, usable as both a CLI tool and a Hermes Agent Skill.

repos.description: 支持 AnyRouter、AgentRouter 的多平台多账号签到，理论兼容所有基于 NewAPI、OneAPI 的平台。
repos.summary_zh: AnyRouter 多账号自动签到工具，支持 AnyRouter 和 AgentRouter 平台，兼容 NewAPI/OneAPI 架构。通过 GitHub Actions 实现定时自动签到，支持多账号并行处理、WAF 绕过及机器人通知，配置灵活且维护良好。
repos.summary_en: A multi-account auto check-in tool for AnyRouter and AgentRouter platforms, compatible with NewAPI/OneAPI architectures. Uses GitHub Actions for scheduled automation, supports parallel account processing, WAF bypass, and notification alerts with flexible configuration.

repos.description: Standalone CliProxyAPI usage tracker with SQLite persistence and built-in dashboard.
repos.summary_zh: CPA Usage Keeper 是一款独立的 CLIProxyAPI 用量持久化与仪表盘服务，通过消费 Redis 队列将 CPA 用量数据写入 SQLite，并提供聚合 API 与内置 Web 仪表盘，支持按时间、模型、API Key 等多维度筛选，可视化展示请求量、Token 消耗、成本、缓存命中率及请求健康度。
repos.summary_en: CPA Usage Keeper is a standalone usage persistence and dashboard service for CLIProxyAPI. It consumes Redis usage events into SQLite, exposes aggregation APIs, and provides a built-in web dashboard for request volume, token usage, cost, cache hit rate, success rate, and multi-dimensional filtering by time, model, API key, and provider.

repos.description: berserkJS 是新形态的前端测试自动化工具 + 页面性能分析工具 ，同时也是个使用 JS 语法控制的命令行浏览器。可用 JS 编写前端自动测试用例 + 页面性能分析用例。 想了解更多？看看连接中的文档吧~~
repos.summary_zh: berserkJS 是一款基于 Qt 的前端自动化测试与页面性能分析工具，支持无头浏览器模式运行主流测试框架，提供 DOM 操作、网络监控、屏幕捕获及性能指标采集功能，API 简洁且符合 W3C 标准，已在微博、Cisco、腾讯等企业落地应用。
repos.summary_en: berserkJS is a Qt-based frontend automation and performance analysis tool that supports headless browser testing with mainstream frameworks, offering DOM manipulation, network monitoring, screenshot capture, and performance metrics collection. Its W3C-compliant APIs are simple and production-proven in enterprises like Sina Weibo, Cisco, and Tencent.

repos.description: django-request is a statistics module for django. It stores requests in a database for admins to see, it can also be used to get statistics on who is online etc.
repos.summary_zh: django-request 是一个为 Django 框架设计的网站统计模块，自动记录用户请求至数据库，支持管理员查看访问数据、在线用户统计及流量分析。通过中间件集成和模板标签，可轻松实现用户活跃度监控与访问趋势可视化，适用于需要精细化运营分析的网站项目。
repos.summary_en: django-request is a Django statistics module that logs HTTP requests to a database for admins to analyze. It enables real-time tracking of online users, visitor statistics, and traffic insights via built-in middleware and template tags, ideal for monitoring user engagement and site performance in Django applications.

repos.description: 微信聊天记录导出、分析工具
repos.summary_zh: Wechat Explorer 是一款专为 iOS 设备设计的微信聊天记录导出与分析工具，通过解析 iTunes 备份中的微信数据，支持导出聊天室记录、统计好友标签及聊天室活跃度，并可生成 HTML 报告转为 PDF，适用于个人数据备份与社交行为分析。
repos.summary_en: Wechat Explorer is an iOS-focused tool for exporting and analyzing WeChat chat records by parsing iTunes backups. It supports exporting chatroom logs, generating friend label statistics, and creating PDF reports from HTML exports, ideal for personal data archiving and social behavior insights.

repos.description: A bilingual teaching guide to Claude Code, organized as a readable   learning path covering architecture, execution flow, tool systems,   and the real writing process behind the guide.
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是一个双语教学指南，旨在从零开始系统学习 Claude Code 源码。通过结构化章节和实际执行流程分析，帮助开发者深入理解其架构设计、工具系统和核心模块。结合 VitePress 构建可导航网站，并提供完整的开发过程记录，适合 AI 编码代理架构研究与自学。
repos.summary_en: This bilingual teaching guide provides a structured learning path to study the Claude Code source code from scratch. It covers architecture, execution flow, tool systems, and real writing processes, enabling readers to build a clear mental model of its design and implementation. Built with VitePress for web navigation and includes full development transcripts.

repos.description: 孙宇晨.skill — 注意力收割操作系统 | Justin Sun Perspective Skill for Claude Code | 由女娲.skill蒸馏
repos.summary_zh: 孙宇晨.skill 是基于1528行调研素材的深度蒸馏成果，提炼出6个核心心智模型与8条决策启发式，构建了一套以‘注意力收割’为核心的营销思维框架。该技能专为 Claude Code 设计，通过模拟孙宇晨的认知模式，提供高冲突性、强传播性的应对策略，适用于公关危机处理、热点事件响应及品牌叙事构建等场景。
repos.summary_en: Sun Yuchen.skill is a distilled framework of 6 core mental models and 8 decision heuristics, built from 1,528 lines of research material. It functions as an 'attention harvesting operating system' for marketing strategy, specifically designed for Claude Code to emulate Sun Yuchen's high-impact, controversial response patterns. It excels in crisis management, trend exploitation, and narrative construction through bold positioning and calculated provocation.
